name: 05663 · Northfield, VT
findings: ZIP 05663 (Northfield) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (86% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05663 (Northfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
